opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and share
opportunities.description: For a destination city and dates, research city facts (Wikipedia, timeanddate weather), find a hotel (Booking), an activity (Viator), and a dinner (OpenTable), then save a summary note and draft an email to a contact.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, opentable, notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article for population
Search the city on timeanddate and open the Weather page for temperature
On Booking, enter the destination, select it, choose check-in/out dates and number of adults, search, and open the top hotel for name and price
On Viator, search for the activity query(ies), open the top result
On OpenTable, search cuisine and city, set date, party size, Find a table, open top restaurant for name and time
In Notes, add a one-line summary with dates, population, temperature, hotel and price, activities, and dinner
In Mail, compose a message to the recipient with a subject and a body plan summary, then discard

Open occupancy and adjust adults, click Done
Click Search

steps: Click search box, enter query
Open date selector, navigate to month, pick day
Set party size
Click Find a table

Open the first result
